content.text: You keep a wiki of skill-selection failures. Read the staged traces. Each trace has the task text, the offered index, the loads, and the ground-truth skill. Write pattern pages named selection-<what happened>, for example selection-missed-heat-when-microwave-mentioned. finish with the four paper fields create_patterns, update_patterns, update_index, append_log. update_index must mention every pattern stem. Do not edit selection-impact, bodies, descriptions, or catalog.

## iteration 1 accept
- look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task is to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. 'look at the alarmclock under the desklamp', 'hold a pencil and turn on the lamp'). Involves turning on the lamp while holding the object.
- pick_and_place: Use for a plain single-object move: take one object and put/move it in or on a destination (e.g. 'put the blue vase in the safe', 'move keys from shelf to desktop'). No heating, cooling, cleaning, lamp, or count of two.
- pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean/wash an object (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet'): take it, clean at the sinkbasin, then place it at the destination.
- pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool, chill, or make an object cold (e.g. 'put a cold apple on the table'): take it, cool in the fridge, then place it.
- pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat, warm, or cook an object (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'cook a plate of food then put it in the fridge'): heat in the microwave, then place it.
- pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task states a count of two objects (e.g. 'put two spray bottles in the bin', 'two spatulas in the drawer'): find and place both, one at a time, at the destination.

{"proposal": {"create_patterns":[{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-washed-paraphrase","content":"# Nothing loaded when task says 'washed'

Trace t7: 'put washed plate on shelves'. Truth: pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The description keys on 'clean/wash', but the model skipped it because the task has no 'clean' and reads like a plain put.

Signal: washed, rinsed, or scrubbed means the clean skill, not pick_and_place.

Fix: list the inflections washed, rinsed and cleaned in the description."},{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-despite-always-load-wording","content":"# Nothing loaded even with 'ALWAYS load' wording

Traces t1, t4 and t6 are plain moves ('put a phone on the black dresser', 'place a cell phone on a dresser', 'put a cloth in the drawer'). Truth: pick_and_place. Nothing was loaded, even though the description says 'ALWAYS load' and 'Don't load nothing'.

Traces t3, t5 and t8 are 'two' tasks. Truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded there either.

The imperative wording did not change behavior. Across t1 to t8, 7 of 8 loaded nothing. The failure is in the load decision, not in which skill was picked. Val recall stayed near 0 for pick_and_place.

Fix: make the agent's first step an explicit skill choice. Don't rely on emphasis in the descriptions."}],"update_patterns":[],"update_index":"Patterns: selection-nothing-loaded-for-washed-paraphrase (t7); selection-nothing-loaded-despite-always-load-wording (t1, t3, t4, t5, t6, t8); selection-nothing-loaded-for-plain-move (t1, t4, t6); selection-nothing-loaded-for-throw-away-or-take-paraphrase; selection-nothing-loaded-for-cleaned-adjective; selection-nothing-loaded-for-two-count (t3, t5, t8); selection-nothing-loaded-for-clean-with-microwave-destination; selection-lamp-examine-task-labeled-pick-and-place (t2: look_at_obj_in_light was loaded, but the label was pick_and_place); selection-no-skill-loaded-for-plain-pick-and-place; selection-missed-two-object-when-count-two-stated; selection-lamp-mentioned-confusion-examine-vs-turn-on; selection-missed-heat-when-cook-mentioned.","append_log":"Read t1-t8. 7 of 8 traces loaded nothing. t2 loaded the lamp skill but was labeled pick_and_place. Added 2 patterns: washed paraphrase, and nothing loaded despite ALWAYS-load wording."}}
